contract_requirement: Stage B reports continuous capital, weekly/monthly final equity distributions, capital occupancy, margin blockers, and executed-trade distribution.

weekly_final_equity.period_definition: UTC ISO week Monday 00:00 through Sunday 23:59:59.999999, clipped to DEVELOPMENT at the final partial week.
weekly_final_equity.equity_rule: Starting EUR200 carried forward; each executed trade changes equity only at its frozen exit close; period final equity is equity after all executed closes at or before that period end.

monthly_final_equity.period_definition: UTC calendar month, clipped to DEVELOPMENT at first/final partial month.
monthly_final_equity.equity_rule: Starting EUR200 carried forward; each executed trade changes equity only at its frozen exit close; period final equity is equity after all executed closes at or before that period end.

capital_occupancy.occupied_minutes: SUM(exit_utc-entry_utc) over actually executed trades only.
capital_occupancy.development_minutes: wall-clock minutes over the frozen DEVELOPMENT domain.
capital_occupancy.time_weighted_margin_eur_over_developmen: SUM(current broker-native side-specific required_margin_eur * executed hold minutes) / development_minutes.
capital_occupancy.maximum_required_margin_eur: MAX side-specific current ExpectedMargin among executed trades.

margin_blockers.count_rule: Count every frozen intent rejected because causal equity at entry is below the side-specific verified current ExpectedMargin.

capital_path_metrics.maximum_drawdown_eur: peak-to-subsequent-trough on starting EUR200 plus executed close-equity path

feasibility_status_law.SURVIVES_CURRENT_CONFIG_EUR200: zero margin blockers AND minimum close-equity > 0
feasibility_status_law.CURRENT_CONFIG_MARGIN_BLOCKED: one or more frozen intents rejected for insufficient current-config margin
feasibility_status_law.CURRENT_CONFIG_CAPITAL_EXHAUSTED: zero margin blockers but minimum close-equity <= 0
feasibility_status_law.survival_conclusion: SURVIVES EUR200 CAPITAL REALIZATION UNDER VERIFIED CURRENT PEPPERSTONE CONFIGURATION APPLIED TO DEVELOPMENT SEQUENCE
